title: Figure 36: Antibodies on cantilever array; Figure 35 SEM of cantilever with vaccinia virus
description: Lower figure is a schematic of a cantilever array with differently colored Y-shaped antibodies binding floating spheres, labeled "Tumour biomarker proteins," "Antibody" and "Bent cantilever," captioned "Figure 36. Antibodies Attached to a Cantilever Array Create Different Specificities to Substances in Blood That are Indicative of Cancer." Upper right is Figure 35, a scanning electron micrograph labeled "Vaccinia Virus Particles" and "Cantilever Beam" with a 1 µm scale bar, captioned "Scanning Electron Micrograph Showing a Cantilever Beam With a Single Vaccinia Virus Particle."
